abheri.name: Abheri
abheri.western: minor pentatonic up, Dorian down - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 6 b7

amritavarshini.name: Amritavarshini
amritavarshini.hi: none standard (Hindustani renditions keep the name)

anandabhairavi.name: Ananda Bhairavi
anandabhairavi.hi: no exact equivalent; Kafi-thaat light ragas (Pilu-like phrases)
anandabhairavi.western: Dorian with zig-zag phrases - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 6 b7

arabhi.name: Arabhi
arabhi.hi: Durga ascending + Bilawal descending (no direct equivalent)
arabhi.western: suspended pentatonic up, major down - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

asavari.name: Asavari
asavari.hi: Natabhairavi family (Carnatic Asaveri is different - janya of 8)
asavari.western: natural minor; ascent pentatonic 1 2 4 5 b6 - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 b6 b7

atana.name: Atana
atana.western: major scale, skipping 3rd and 6th ascending - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

basant.name: Basant
basant.hi: Kamavardhini family (no exact Carnatic raga; unrelated to Carnatic Vasantha)
basant.western: Purvi scale: double harmonic with #4 - degrees 1 b2 3 #4 5 b6 7

begada.name: Begada
begada.western: major scale with zig-zag ascent - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 b7 7

behag.name: Behag
behag.hi: Behag is used in both systems
behag.western: major scale with #4 as a passing note - degrees 1 2 3 4 #4 5 6 7

bhairavi.name: Bhairavi
bhairavi.hi: no exact equivalent (NOT Hindustani Bhairavi); closest Asavari/Jaunpuri with shuddha dha ascending
bhairavi.western: natural minor with raised 6th ascending (Dorian up, Aeolian down) - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 b6 6 b7

bhoopalam.name: Bhoopalam
bhoopalam.western: pentatonic 1 b2 b3 5 b6 - degrees 1 b2 b3 5 b6

bilahari.name: Bilahari
bilahari.western: major pentatonic up, major scale down - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

bowli.name: Bowli
bowli.western: pentatonic 1 b2 3 5 b6 up - degrees 1 b2 3 5 b6 7

brindavanasaranga.name: Brindavanasaranga
brindavanasaranga.western: 1 2 4 5 7 up; 1 2 b3 4 5 b7 down - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 b7 7

chakravakam.name: Chakravakam
chakravakam.western: Mixolydian b2 (Phrygian dominant with natural 6) - degrees 1 b2 3 4 5 6 b7

chandrakauns.name: Chandrakauns
chandrakauns.western: pentatonic 1 b3 4 b6 7 - degrees 1 b3 4 b6 7

charukesi.name: Charukesi
charukesi.western: Mixolydian b6 (Aeolian dominant, 5th mode of melodic minor) - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 b6 b7

chenchurutti.name: Chenchurutti
chenchurutti.western: Mixolydian, sung low (from the 6th below Sa up to b7) - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 b7

darbarikanada.name: Darbari Kanada
darbarikanada.western: natural minor (Aeolian) with zig-zag phrases - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 b6 b7

desh.name: Desh
desh.hi: Desh (Carnatic Desh / close to Kedaragowla + Surati)
desh.western: Mixolydian down, major 7 up (major/Mixolydian mix) - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 b7 7

dharmavati.name: Dharmavati
dharmavati.hi: Madhuvanti (same seven notes; Madhuvanti omits R, D in ascent)
dharmavati.western: Lydian diminished (melodic minor with #4) - degrees 1 2 b3 #4 5 6 7

dwijavanthi.name: Dwijavanthi
dwijavanthi.western: Mixolydian with a b3 grace in the descent (and an occasional 7) - degrees 1 2 b3 3 4 5 6 b7

gaudmalhar.name: Gaudmalhar
gaudmalhar.western: major scale with a b7 also used coming down (both 7ths) - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 b7 7

gorakhkalyan.name: Gorakh Kalyan
gorakhkalyan.hi: close to Carnatic Andolika / Madhyamavati family

gourimanohari.name: Gourimanohari
gourimanohari.western: melodic minor (ascending form / jazz minor) - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 6 7

hamsadhwani.name: Hamsadhwani
hamsadhwani.western: pentatonic 1 2 3 5 7 (major pentatonic with 7 instead of 6) - degrees 1 2 3 5 7

hamsanandi.name: Hamsanandi
hamsanandi.hi: Sohini (same notes; Marwa and Puriya also share this hexatonic set)

hanumatodi.name: Hanuma Todi
hanumatodi.western: Phrygian - degrees 1 b2 b3 4 5 b6 b7

hemavati.name: Hemavati
hemavati.western: Ukrainian Dorian (Dorian #4, Romanian minor) - degrees 1 2 b3 #4 5 6 b7

hindolam.name: Hindolam
hindolam.western: pentatonic 1 b3 4 b6 b7 (Malkauns scale; a mode of the major pentatonic) - degrees 1 b3 4 b6 b7

hindustanibhairavi.name: Hindustani Bhairavi
hindustanibhairavi.western: Phrygian - degrees 1 b2 b3 4 5 b6 b7

jaijaiwanti.name: Jaijaiwanti
jaijaiwanti.western: major/Mixolydian mix with b3 grace - degrees 1 2 b3 3 4 5 6 b7 7

janasammodini.name: Janasammodini
janasammodini.western: major pentatonic with b7 - degrees 1 2 3 5 6 b7

jaunpuri.name: Jaunpuri
jaunpuri.western: natural minor (ascent skips 3rd) - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 b6 b7

jog.name: Jog
jog.western: 1 3 4 5 b7 with b3 descending (blues-like) - degrees 1 b3 3 4 5 b7

kadanakuthuhalam.name: Kadanakuthuhalam
kadanakuthuhalam.western: major scale with leaping ascent - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

kalyanavasantham.name: Kalyanavasantham
kalyanavasantham.western: harmonic minor (ascent 1 b3 4 b6 7) - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 b6 7

kamavardhini.name: Kamavardhini
kamavardhini.western: double harmonic major with #4 - degrees 1 b2 3 #4 5 b6 7

kambhoji.name: Kambhoji
kambhoji.western: Mixolydian; major 7 only below the tonic - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 b7 7

kapi.name: Kapi
kapi.western: Dorian with major 7 ascending - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 6 b7 7

kedar.name: Kedar
kedar.western: major scale with both 4 and #4 - degrees 1 2 3 4 #4 5 6 7

kedaragowla.name: Kedara Gowla
kedaragowla.hi: close to Des / Tilak Kamod family (Khamaj thaat) without N3
kedaragowla.western: Mixolydian; ascent skips 3rd and 6th - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 b7

kurinji.name: Kurinji
kurinji.hi: Bilawal notes in a short range
kurinji.western: major scale in a narrow range below and above the tonic - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

lalitha.name: Lalitha
lalitha.western: hexatonic 1 b2 3 4 b6 7 (no 5th) - degrees 1 b2 3 4 b6 7

maand.name: Maand
maand.western: major scale with folk turns - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

madhuvanti.name: Madhuvanti
madhuvanti.western: Lydian diminished (melodic minor with #4) - degrees 1 2 b3 #4 5 6 7

madhyamavati.name: Madhyamavati
madhyamavati.western: suspended pentatonic 1 2 4 5 b7 (Egyptian / 'sus' pentatonic) - degrees 1 2 4 5 b7

malahari.name: Malahari
malahari.western: 1 b2 4 5 b6 going up, adds 3 coming down (double harmonic without 7) - degrees 1 b2 3 4 5 b6

malayamarutham.name: Malayamarutham
malayamarutham.hi: none standard (Ahir Bhairav notes without ma)
malayamarutham.western: hexatonic 1 b2 3 5 6 b7 - degrees 1 b2 3 5 6 b7

manirangu.name: Manirangu
manirangu.western: 1 2 4 5 b7 going up, adds b3 coming down (Dorian without 6) - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 b7

mayamalavagowla.name: Mayamalava Gowla
mayamalavagowla.western: double harmonic major (Byzantine, Hijaz Kar) - degrees 1 b2 3 4 5 b6 7

mishrashivaranjani.name: Mishrashivaranjani
mishrashivaranjani.western: minor pentatonic with major 6th (1 2 b3 5 6) plus a major 3rd touched coming down - degrees 1 2 b3 3 5 6

mohanam.name: Mohanam
mohanam.hi: Bhupali (Bhoop); also Deshkar uses same notes

mukhari.name: Mukhari
mukhari.western: Dorian up, Aeolian down - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 b6 6 b7

narayani.name: Narayani
narayani.western: Mixolydian without the 3rd; b7 only coming down - degrees 1 2 4 5 6 b7

natabhairavi.name: Nata Bhairavi
natabhairavi.western: natural minor (Aeolian) - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 b6 b7

natakapriya.name: Natakapriya
natakapriya.western: Dorian b2 (2nd mode of melodic minor) - degrees 1 b2 b3 4 5 6 b7

navaroj.name: Navaroj
navaroj.hi: Bilawal notes in a Pa-to-Pa range
navaroj.western: major scale notes sung from the 5th below to the 5th - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

neelambari.name: Neelambari
neelambari.western: major scale with zig-zag phrases - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

pahadi.name: Pahadi
pahadi.western: major pentatonic ascent; major scale descent - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

pilu.name: Pilu
pilu.western: Dorian / major mix; chromatic in light music - degrees 1 2 b3 3 4 5 6 b7 7

purnachandrika.name: Purnachandrika
purnachandrika.western: major scale (Ionian) with zigzag phrases; 6 only going up, 7 only coming down - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

purvi.name: Purvi
purvi.western: double harmonic with #4 and natural 4 descending - degrees 1 b2 3 4 #4 5 b6 7

rageshri.name: Rageshri
rageshri.western: Mixolydian without the 5th: 1 3 4 6 b7 up, 2 only coming down - degrees 1 2 3 4 6 b7

reethigowla.name: Reethi Gowla
reethigowla.western: Dorian, zig-zag; P weak - degrees 1 2 b3 4 5 6 b7

revagupti.name: Revagupti
revagupti.western: pentatonic 1 b2 3 5 b6 (double harmonic scale without 4 and 7) - degrees 1 b2 3 5 b6

revati.name: Revati
revati.western: pentatonic 1 b2 4 5 b7 - degrees 1 b2 4 5 b7

sahana.name: Sahana
sahana.hi: no exact equivalent (Khamaj family; not Hindustani Shahana Kanada)
sahana.western: Mixolydian with zig-zag phrases - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 b7

sama.name: Sama
sama.western: suspended pentatonic up, adds 3rd descending - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6

sarasangi.name: Sarasangi
sarasangi.western: harmonic major (major with flat 6) - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 b6 7

saveri.name: Saveri
saveri.western: pentatonic 1 b2 4 5 b6 up, double harmonic major down - degrees 1 b2 3 4 5 b6 7

shanmukhapriya.name: Shanmukhapriya
shanmukhapriya.western: Aeolian #4 (natural minor with raised 4th) - degrees 1 2 b3 #4 5 b6 b7

shivaranjani.name: Shivaranjani
shivaranjani.western: minor pentatonic with major 6th (1 2 b3 5 6) - degrees 1 2 b3 5 6

shubhapantuvarali.name: Shubhapantu Varali
shubhapantuvarali.western: Phrygian #4 with major 7th - degrees 1 b2 b3 #4 5 b6 7

shyamkalyan.name: Shyam Kalyan
shyamkalyan.western: Lydian with the natural 4th also used (both 4ths); no 6 going up - degrees 1 2 3 4 #4 5 6 7

simhendramadhyamam.name: Simhendramadhyamam
simhendramadhyamam.western: Hungarian minor (harmonic minor with #4) - degrees 1 2 b3 #4 5 b6 7

sindhubhairavi.name: Sindhu Bhairavi
sindhubhairavi.western: Phrygian/Aeolian blend - natural minor with b2 descending; chromatic in practice - degrees 1 b2 2 b3 4 5 b6 b7
sindhubhairavi.mood: pathos, devotion; very common for bhajans and closing pieces

sri.name: Sri
sri.western: Dorian-flavoured: 1 2 4 5 b7 up, 1 b7 6 5 4 2 b3 2 down

sriranjani.name: Sriranjani
sriranjani.hi: Bageshri (close; Bageshri adds P in some phrases)
sriranjani.western: Dorian without 5th (hexatonic 1 2 b3 4 6 b7) - degrees 1 2 b3 4 6 b7

tilakkamod.name: Tilakkamod
tilakkamod.western: major scale with zig-zag phrases - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 7

tilang.name: Tilang
tilang.western: pentatonic-ish 1 3 4 5 7 up, 1 3 4 5 b7 down - degrees 1 3 4 5 b7 7

vachaspati.name: Vachaspati
vachaspati.hi: Saraswati family (Vachaspati scale; adopted as Vachaspati)

vakulabharanam.name: Vakulabharanam
vakulabharanam.western: Phrygian dominant (5th mode of harmonic minor) - degrees 1 b2 3 4 5 b6 b7

vasantha.name: Vasantha
vasantha.hi: no equivalent (unrelated to Hindustani Basant despite the name)

yadukulakambhoji.name: Yadukulakambhoji
yadukulakambhoji.hi: close to Hindustani Jhinjhoti / Pahadi-like folk feel
yadukulakambhoji.western: suspended pentatonic up, Mixolydian down - degrees 1 2 3 4 5 6 b7

keherwa.name: Keherwa
keherwa.feel: The default bhajan, folk and film-song taal; steady 4-beat pulse.

dadra.name: Dadra
dadra.feel: Lilting 6-beat taal of bhajans, ghazals, lullabies and folk songs.

rupak.name: Rupak
rupak.feel: Asymmetric 7 that starts on the empty (khali) beat; light classical, bhajans, film songs.

adi.name: Adi
adi.clap: clap, pinky, ring, middle | clap, wave | clap, wave
adi.western: 4/4 (8 beats = one 8/8 bar or two 4/4 bars; 2-kalai adi = 16)
adi.feel: The default Carnatic tala for kritis and most South-Indian bhajans.

rupakam.name: Rupakam
rupakam.clap: clap, wave | clap, pinky, ring, middle
rupakam.feel: Common in kritis and devotional songs; a 3-feel in light music.

mishrachapu.name: Mishrachapu
mishrachapu.clap: wave (or silent) on 1, clap on 4, clap on 6 - 'ta ki ta | ta ka | dhi mi'
mishrachapu.feel: Lilting 7 used for padams, devotional songs and many bhajans.

khandachapu.name: Khandachapu
khandachapu.clap: clap on 1 and 3 - 'ta ka | ta ki ta'
khandachapu.feel: Brisk 5 used in devotional songs, tillanas and javalis.
